review_notes.detail: All 36 A1 card portions and 72 printed input terminals were checked against enlarged native TIFF crops. Their literal fields match the source, with no unreadable characters.
Native footer AA4 continuation appears 02B-B3A3B05; A1 socket listing records socket A3T, pin B05. Retain the literal footer while this physical glyph remains under review.

RT581 enlarged native source: AQ 1A roof ~150 px; 1B 565; 3B 570; 4B 565; 5C 992; 6B 569; 7B 569. Twelve-roof fit: 59.735 px per row, origin 29.888 px. Provisional handoff proof misidentified an interior body line as first roof. The 4B OR OR card is truly on B row; no grid-label exception.

AS5E has a seven-row body (native roof row30, grid row36), while BS5M has an eight-row body (roof row79, grid row86). Enlarged native crops show both upper inputs at +1, lower inputs at +5, and outputs at +3. AJ/BJ feed upper inputs and AP/BP lower inputs on separate c138 stems.

Wide native BQ crop shows its B03 lower output running to c92, rising across the upper-output row without a diamond, then reaching +PADDL 59 at row47. AR G05 descends at c87, bends at row38, crosses storage row37 without a diamond and reaches +SADDL 02 at row36 through c199.
AG D10 is fed by an unlabeled short line across columns 135–138 at row1, then a vertical stem to row5. Native top bank crop confirms the shape; no signal name is inferred.

Native horizontal and vertical occupancy comparison supports the bank rails and independent crossings. Enlarged source crops fix the lower +LS BUS-27 at c105, upper +LS BUS-26 at c109, BG-to-BE at c158, BD storage at c160, upper AE/AF-to-AB at c176, lower BE/BF-to-BB at c182/184, and the separate AR and BQ export paths.
